title: Aplikasi Toko Online - Threat Model
description: Threat Model untuk Aplikasi Manajemen Toko Online (threaddragon.com) dengan React Frontend, Node.js API, MySQL Database, Redis Cache, dan Payment Gateway Integration
author: Security Team

elements.name: Customer
elements.description: User yang melakukan registrasi, login, belanja, dan pembayaran

elements.name: Admin
elements.description: Admin user yang mengelola produk, order, dan transaksi

elements.name: Payment Gateway (Midtrans/Xendit)
elements.description: External payment provider untuk proses pembayaran dan verifikasi transaksi

elements.name: React Frontend
elements.description: User Interface Layer - Aplikasi web React untuk customer dan admin

elements.name: Node.js REST API Server
elements.description: Backend API - Business logic, authentication, order processing, payment handling

elements.name: MySQL Database
elements.description: Primary data storage untuk user, products, orders, transactions

elements.name: Redis Cache
elements.description: In-memory cache untuk session, user data, product cache

elements.name: Email Service
elements.description: Email notification service untuk order confirmation, password reset, alerts

elements.name: Authentication Module
elements.description: JWT token generation, validation, refresh token management

dataFlows.name: User Input & Browse
dataFlows.description: Customer melakukan input (login, register, search, order)

dataFlows.name: Admin Management
dataFlows.description: Admin mengelola produk, order, dan transaksi melalui frontend

dataFlows.name: REST API Calls
dataFlows.description: Frontend melakukan HTTP request ke backend API

dataFlows.name: Database Queries
dataFlows.description: API melakukan query ke MySQL database

dataFlows.name: Cache Operations
dataFlows.description: API cache session dan data ke Redis

dataFlows.name: Payment Request & Verification
dataFlows.description: API mengirim payment request dan menerima webhook callback

dataFlows.name: Webhook Callback
dataFlows.description: Payment gateway mengirim webhook untuk payment status update

dataFlows.name: Email Notification
dataFlows.description: API mengirim email untuk order confirmation, alerts, password reset

dataFlows.name: Authentication
dataFlows.description: API menggunakan auth module untuk token generation dan validation

threats.title: Spoofing Identitas User - Session Hijacking
threats.description: Attacker dapat mencuri JWT token melalui XSS atau network sniffing untuk mengakses akun user

vulnerabilityDetails.root_cause: Token tidak memiliki expiration pendek dan disimpan insecure

detailedScenario.step1: Attacker inject XSS payload di kolom comment produk:
detailedScenario.step2: Customer membuka page dengan comment tersebut
detailedScenario.step3: JWT token dari localStorage terkirim ke attacker
detailedScenario.step4: Attacker menggunakan token untuk membuat request authenticated
detailedScenario.step5: Attacker dapat mengakses akun, mengubah data, atau membuat pembelian

mitigations.title: Implementasi Token Expiration
mitigations.description: JWT token harus memiliki short expiration time
mitigations.implementation: Set exp claim: 30 menit untuk access token, 7 hari untuk refresh token

mitigations.title: Gunakan HttpOnly & Secure Cookie
mitigations.description: Simpan token dalam HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite cookie, bukan localStorage
mitigations.implementation: res.cookie('jwt', token, { httpOnly: true, secure: true, sameSite: 'Strict' })

mitigations.title: Implementasi Token Rotation
mitigations.description: Refresh token harus di-rotate setiap kali digunakan
mitigations.implementation: Setiap refresh request return new refresh token + new access token

mitigations.title: CSRF Protection
mitigations.description: Implementasi CSRF token untuk state-changing operations
mitigations.implementation: Set SameSite=Strict, implementasi CSRF token untuk POST/PUT/DELETE

mitigations.title: XSS Prevention
mitigations.description: Implement input validation dan output encoding
mitigations.implementation: Sanitize user input, encode output, use Content Security Policy (CSP)

mitigations.title: Monitor Suspicious Login Activity
mitigations.description: Alert jika login dari IP/device baru atau unusual patterns
mitigations.implementation: Log semua login attempts, compare dengan historical IP/device data

threats.title: Tampering Data Harga Produk
threats.description: Attacker dapat mengubah harga produk di frontend sebelum melakukan pembayaran
attackVector: Modifying network request dengan proxy tools
Direct API call dengan parameter harga yang salah

detailedScenario.step3: Customer inspect element, temukan input dengan value harga original: 500000
detailedScenario.step7: API tidak validasi harga, langsung accept

mitigations.title: Server-side Price Validation (WAJIB)
mitigations.description: Selalu validasi harga di backend sebelum order diproses
mitigations.implementation: Backend ambil harga dari database, bandingkan dengan request, jika tidak match reject order
mitigations.code_example: const dbPrice = await Product.findById(productId).select('price'); if(dbPrice !== requestPrice) { throw new Error('Price mismatch'); }

mitigations.title: Calculate Total di Server
mitigations.description: Calculate order total harga di backend, jangan trust frontend calculation
mitigations.implementation: Backend iterate setiap item, ambil harga current dari DB, calculate total, bandingkan dengan request total

mitigations.title: Digital Signature pada Order Data
mitigations.description: Sign order data dengan HMAC untuk detect tampering
mitigations.implementation: HMAC-SHA256(order_data + secret_key) = signature, verify di server

mitigations.title: Database Constraints
mitigations.description: Implementasi database constraints untuk data integrity
mitigations.implementation: PRIMARY KEY, UNIQUE, NOT NULL constraints, CHECK constraints untuk price > 0

mitigations.title: Audit Logging untuk Perubahan Harga
mitigations.description: Log semua perubahan harga produk dengan timestamp, user, old value, new value
mitigations.implementation: Create audit_log table, log setiap UPDATE pada product.price

threats.title: Information Disclosure - Kebocoran Data Customer
threats.description: Attacker dapat mengakses data customer yang sensitive melalui API endpoint yang tidak ter-protect
attackVector: API responses memuat sensitive data tanpa masking

detailedScenario.step1: Attacker melakukan reconnaissance pada API endpoints
detailedScenario.step2: Attacker find endpoint /api/users yang tidak require authentication
detailedScenario.step4: API return full user database dengan email, phone, address, password hash
detailedScenario.step5: Attacker extract data, perform credential stuffing attack

mitigations.title: Encrypt Sensitive Data at Rest
mitigations.description: Encrypt PII dan financial data di database menggunakan AES-256
mitigations.implementation: Implement field-level encryption untuk email, phone, address, ssn, credit card, dll

mitigations.title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
mitigations.description: Implementasi authorization check pada setiap endpoint
mitigations.implementation: Middleware untuk verify user role, only return data user own atau admin authorized

mitigations.title: API Data Masking
mitigations.description: Mask sensitive data di API responses
mitigations.implementation: Email: user****@domain.com, Phone: 0812****6789, tidak return password hash

mitigations.title: Parametrized Queries (Prevent SQL Injection)
mitigations.description: Gunakan parameterized queries untuk semua database operations
mitigations.implementation: Use prepared statements dengan placeholder ? atau named parameters

mitigations.title: Encrypt Database Backups
mitigations.description: Semua database backups harus di-encrypt dengan strong cipher
mitigations.implementation: GPG encryption atau AWS KMS untuk backup files

mitigations.title: Error Handling - No Info Disclosure
mitigations.description: Jangan expose database details di error messages
mitigations.implementation: Return generic error message ke client, log detailed error server-side

mitigations.title: HTTPS Only Communication
mitigations.description: Semua communication harus encrypted dengan TLS 1.2+
mitigations.implementation: HTTP to HTTPS redirect, HSTS headers, disable weak ciphers

threats.title: Denial of Service (DoS) - Server Overload
threats.description: Attacker dapat overload server dengan request volume tinggi, menyebabkan service unavailable

detailedScenario.step1: Attacker membuat bot script untuk send 10,000 requests/detik
detailedScenario.step3: Server queue penuh, tidak bisa handle request baru

mitigations.title: Rate Limiting
mitigations.description: Limit request rate per IP address
mitigations.implementation: 10 requests per minute per IP, exponential backoff for repeated violations

mitigations.title: CAPTCHA untuk Forms
mitigations.description: Protect login, registration, contact forms dengan CAPTCHA
mitigations.implementation: Google reCAPTCHA v3 atau hCaptcha

mitigations.title: DDoS Protection Service
mitigations.description: Use CDN dengan built-in DDoS protection
mitigations.implementation: CloudFlare, AWS CloudFront, atau Akamai

mitigations.title: Database Connection Pooling
mitigations.description: Limit dan reuse database connections
mitigations.implementation: Connection pool size: 20-50 connections, timeout: 30 seconds

mitigations.title: Request Queuing & Throttling
mitigations.description: Queue excessive requests untuk processing later
mitigations.implementation: Bull queue, Redis-based queue untuk async processing

mitigations.title: Email Rate Limiting
mitigations.description: Limit email sending per user
mitigations.implementation: Max 5 emails per minute per user, prevent email bombing

mitigations.title: Web Application Firewall (WAF)
mitigations.description: Configure WAF rules untuk detect dan block attack patterns
mitigations.implementation: AWS WAF, ModSecurity, atau CloudFlare WAF

threats.title: Elevation of Privilege - Unauthorized Admin Access
threats.description: Regular user dapat mengakses admin functions atau escalate privilege mereka
attackVector: Missing authorization checks pada admin endpoints
Direct API call ke admin endpoints

detailedScenario.step1: Customer login dengan akun biasa, dapat JWT token dengan role='user'
detailedScenario.step3: API tidak check apakah user adalah admin
detailedScenario.step4: API return semua products data (termasuk cost, profit margin)
detailedScenario.step5: Customer dapat juga POST /api/admin/products/1 untuk ubah harga
detailedScenario.step6: Customer atau attacker ubah semua product prices

mitigations.title: JWT Role-Based Authorization
mitigations.description: Include role dalam JWT token dan verify pada setiap endpoint
mitigations.implementation: JWT payload: {sub: userId, role: 'admin', iat: ..., exp: ...}

mitigations.title: Authorization Middleware
mitigations.description: Implementasi middleware untuk verify authorization sebelum handler execute
mitigations.implementation: app.use('/api/admin', requireRole('admin'), adminHandler)

mitigations.title: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) untuk Admin
mitigations.description: Mandatory MFA untuk semua admin accounts
mitigations.implementation: TOTP (Google Authenticator) atau U2F key

mitigations.title: IP Whitelisting untuk Admin Panel
mitigations.description: Restrict admin panel access hanya dari whitelisted IP addresses
mitigations.implementation: Admin access hanya dari office/VPN IP, deny others

mitigations.title: Comprehensive Audit Logging
mitigations.description: Log semua admin actions dengan detail (who, what, when, where, why)
mitigations.implementation: Log CREATE, READ, UPDATE, DELETE operations untuk sensitive resources

mitigations.title: Admin Session Timeout
mitigations.description: Force logout admin setelah inactivity
mitigations.implementation: 15 minutes inactivity timeout, require re-authentication

mitigations.title: Principle of Least Privilege
mitigations.description: Grant minimal permissions untuk setiap admin user
mitigations.implementation: Super Admin, Product Manager, Order Manager, Reporting - different roles

threats.title: Tampering Transaksi Pembayaran
threats.description: Attacker dapat memanipulasi status transaksi pembayaran tanpa benar-benar melakukan pembayaran

detailedScenario.step1: Customer melakukan order dan initiate payment via Midtrans
detailedScenario.step2: Attacker intercept payment webhook callback dengan proxy tool (Burp Suite)
detailedScenario.step4: Attacker send modified webhook ke server /api/webhook/payment
detailedScenario.step5: Server tidak verify signature, accept webhook tanpa validasi
detailedScenario.step6: Order diproses sebagai 'paid' meskipun payment belum diterima

mitigations.title: Webhook Signature Verification (WAJIB)
mitigations.description: Verify HMAC signature dari payment provider pada setiap webhook
mitigations.implementation: Compute HMAC-SHA256(webhook_body + merchant_key), compare dengan header signature

mitigations.title: Server-side Payment Status Verification
mitigations.description: Jangan trust status dari webhook callback, query payment provider untuk verify
mitigations.implementation: Setelah menerima webhook, query Midtrans/Xendit API untuk confirm payment status

mitigations.title: Idempotency Key untuk Duplicate Prevention
mitigations.description: Use idempotency key untuk prevent duplicate order processing
mitigations.implementation: Generate unique idempotency key per payment, reject duplicate requests

mitigations.title: Transaction Timeout
mitigations.description: Auto-cancel pending payments setelah timeout
mitigations.implementation: If payment not completed dalam 15 menit, mark order as cancelled

mitigations.title: Merchant Key Rotation
mitigations.description: Rotate merchant key secara berkala untuk reduce exposure
mitigations.implementation: Change merchant key setiap 6 bulan, support dual key during transition

mitigations.title: Payment Transaction Logging & Auditing
mitigations.description: Log semua payment events untuk audit trail
mitigations.implementation: Log: transaction_id, amount, status, timestamp, webhook received, verification result

mitigations.title: Fraud Detection System
mitigations.description: Implement fraud detection untuk detect suspicious transactions
mitigations.implementation: Alert if amount > threshold, frequency > limit, unusual patterns

threats.title: SQL Injection Attack
threats.description: Attacker dapat inject SQL commands melalui unsanitized input untuk mengakses atau memodifikasi database

detailedScenario.step3: Backend query: SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%' OR '1'='1%'
detailedScenario.step4: Query always true, return semua products termasuk internal data
detailedScenario.step5: Attacker perform UNION-based injection: ' UNION SELECT user, password FROM admin--
detailedScenario.step6: Attacker mendapat list semua admin credentials

mitigations.title: Parameterized Queries (Prepared Statements)
mitigations.description: WAJIB gunakan parameterized queries untuk semua database operations
mitigations.implementation: Gunakan ? placeholder atau named parameters, never string concatenation
mitigations.code_example: db.query('SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE ?', [searchTerm])

mitigations.title: Input Validation & Sanitization
mitigations.description: Validate semua input sebelum digunakan dalam query
mitigations.implementation: Whitelist allowed characters, reject special characters, length validation

mitigations.title: Use ORM Framework
mitigations.description: Use ORM untuk abstract SQL queries dan prevent injection
mitigations.implementation: Sequelize, TypeORM, Prisma - provide query builder dengan built-in escaping

mitigations.title: Database Least Privilege
mitigations.description: Create DB user dengan minimal permissions
mitigations.implementation: App user only have SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE permissions, not DROP/ALTER

mitigations.title: Error Handling - Hide Database Details
mitigations.description: Don't expose SQL error messages di responses
mitigations.implementation: Catch exceptions, log server-side, return generic error message

mitigations.title: WAF Rules untuk SQL Injection
mitigations.description: Configure WAF untuk detect dan block SQL injection patterns
mitigations.implementation: ModSecurity rules, AWS WAF SQL injection patterns

mitigations.title: Regular Penetration Testing
mitigations.description: Conduct regular SAST dan penetration testing untuk find vulnerabilities
mitigations.implementation: Monthly automated SAST scanning, quarterly manual penetration testing

threats.title: Repudiation - User Deny Transaksi
threats.description: User dapat menyangkal bahwa mereka melakukan transaksi tertentu karena tidak ada proof

detailedScenario.step1: User melakukan order barang senilai Rp1.000.000
detailedScenario.step2: Kemudian user deny: 'Saya tidak order barang ini, akun saya mungkin ter-hack'
detailedScenario.step3: Company tidak punya bukti siapa yang melakukan order
detailedScenario.step4: Sistem tidak log IP address, device, timestamp
detailedScenario.step5: Company tidak bisa prove user adalah yang order, claim refund

mitigations.title: Comprehensive Audit Logging
mitigations.description: Log semua user actions dengan detail lengkap
mitigations.implementation: Log: user_id, action, IP address, user_agent, timestamp, result

mitigations.title: Transaction Signing
mitigations.description: Sign setiap transaction dengan digital signature
mitigations.implementation: HMAC-SHA256(transaction_data + user_secret), store signature

mitigations.title: Immutable Transaction Records
mitigations.description: Create append-only transaction log yang tidak bisa dimodifikasi
mitigations.implementation: Separate immutable_transactions table, no UPDATE/DELETE allowed

mitigations.title: Email Confirmation untuk Transaksi
mitigations.description: Send confirmation email untuk setiap transaksi penting
mitigations.implementation: Order confirmation email harus include transaction details, link untuk dispute

mitigations.title: 2FA untuk Sensitive Actions
mitigations.description: Require 2FA confirmation untuk high-value transactions
mitigations.implementation: If amount > Rp500.000, require OTP confirmation via email/SMS

mitigations.title: Device Fingerprinting
mitigations.description: Capture device information untuk identify legitimate vs unauthorized access
mitigations.implementation: Log: user_agent, IP address, device fingerprint, geolocation

mitigations.title: Immutable Audit Log Storage
mitigations.description: Store audit logs di immutable storage dengan tamper-proof mechanism
mitigations.implementation: Use blockchain, append-only database, atau cryptographic hash chain

threats.title: Command Injection - Email Header Injection
threats.description: Attacker dapat inject commands di email headers untuk spam atau send ke unauthorized recipients
attackVector: Raw user input dalam email headers

detailedScenario.step2: System send confirmation email dengan header: Bcc: attacker@evil.com
detailedScenario.step3: Email terkirim ke both legitimate customer AND attacker
detailedScenario.step4: Attacker dapat inject To, Cc, Bcc headers untuk spam campaign

mitigations.title: Email Header Sanitization
mitigations.description: Sanitize semua email parameters sebelum digunakan
mitigations.implementation: Remove newlines, carriage returns, semicolons dari email parameters

mitigations.title: Input Validation
mitigations.description: Validate email format dan name format
mitigations.implementation: Name: max 100 chars, alphanumeric + spaces only, reject special chars

mitigations.title: Use Template Engine
mitigations.description: Gunakan template engine yang aman untuk generate email
mitigations.implementation: Handlebars, EJS dengan automatic escaping

mitigations.title: SPF, DKIM, DMARC Configuration
mitigations.description: Configure DNS records untuk prevent email spoofing
mitigations.implementation: Setup SPF record, DKIM signing, DMARC policy

securityRequirements.title: Secure Authentication & Token Management
securityRequirements.description: Implement secure JWT-based authentication dengan proper token lifecycle management
acceptanceCriteria: JWT access token expiration: 30 menit
JWT refresh token expiration: 7 hari dengan rotation strategy
Tokens disimpan dalam HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict cookies
CSRF protection implementasi untuk state-changing operations
Failed login attempts dibatasi max 5x per 15 menit dengan exponential backoff
Login history logged dengan IP address, user agent, device fingerprint
Logout harus invalidate token di server-side (blacklist atau revoke)
Session timeout untuk inactivity: 15 menit
MFA mandatory untuk admin accounts (TOTP preferred)
testCases: Attempt login dengan wrong password 6x, verify lockout
Extract JWT token, wait 31 minutes, attempt API call, verify failure
Logout dan attempt API call dengan old token, verify failure
Check cookie attributes: HttpOnly=true, Secure=true, SameSite=Strict

securityRequirements.title: Data Encryption at Rest & In Transit
securityRequirements.description: Encrypt sensitive data di database dan dalam komunikasi network
acceptanceCriteria: Semua data sensitive di database encrypted dengan AES-256
Sensitive fields: email, phone, address, password_hash, credit_card (partial)
Database connection menggunakan SSL/TLS encryption
API communication exclusively HTTPS (TLS 1.2 atau lebih tinggi)
Weak TLS ciphers disabled (no RC4, DES, 3DES, MD5)
Encryption keys stored dalam dedicated key management service (AWS KMS, HashiCorp Vault)
Key rotation policy: setiap 90 hari untuk data encryption keys
Database backups encrypted dengan strong cipher
PII data di API responses harus masked (email: user****@mail.com)
Sensitive data dalam logs harus redacted/masked
testCases: Verify TLS version: openssl s_client -connect api.server:443
Check database encryption: query SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'default_encryption_algorithm'
Verify email stored encrypted: SELECT email FROM users WHERE id=1 (should be binary/encrypted)
Check API response: verify email is masked in JSON response

securityRequirements.title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Implementation
securityRequirements.description: Implement fine-grained access control berdasarkan user roles
acceptanceCriteria: Setiap API endpoint memiliki authorization check dengan role verification
Minimal 3 roles: user, product_manager, admin dengan distinct permissions
User hanya dapat mengakses resources milik mereka sendiri
Admin endpoints require MFA authentication
Admin access restricted to whitelisted IP addresses (office/VPN only)
No endpoint should be accessible without authentication (except login/register)
Default-deny principle: jika tidak explicit allow, maka deny
Permission matrix documented dan version controlled
Regular audit untuk unusual access patterns dan privilege escalation attempts
Access denied attempts harus di-log dan di-alert
testCases: As regular user, attempt GET /api/admin/products, verify 403 Forbidden
As regular user, attempt PUT /api/users/2 (other user), verify 403
As admin without MFA, attempt admin endpoint, verify 401
Check audit logs for access denied attempts

securityRequirements.title: Comprehensive Input Validation & Injection Prevention
securityRequirements.description: Validate dan sanitize semua user input untuk prevent injection attacks
acceptanceCriteria: Semua input dari user harus di-validate pada server-side (NEVER trust client)
Parameterized queries/prepared statements mandatory untuk semua database operations
Output encoding untuk prevent XSS (HTML entity encoding minimum)
Input size limits enforced (max 100KB per request, max 10KB per field)
Whitelist approach untuk acceptable input patterns (regex validation)
Special characters handled safely (no raw characters dalam queries/commands)
Rate limiting implementasi: 10 requests per minute per IP untuk public endpoints
CAPTCHA untuk sensitive operations: login, registration, payment
Content Security Policy (CSP) headers configured (frame-ancestors, script-src)
Error messages tidak expose system details atau input values
testCases: Attempt SQL injection: GET /api/products?search=' OR '1'='1, verify prevention
Attempt XSS: POST comment dengan <script>alert('xss')</script>, verify encoding
Send oversized payload (100MB), verify rejection
Check CSP headers: curl -I https://api.server | grep Content-Security-Policy
Rate limit test: send 11 requests in 1 minute, verify throttling on 11th

securityRequirements.title: Secure Payment Processing & Transaction Integrity
securityRequirements.description: Ensure secure payment handling dengan comprehensive validation dan fraud prevention
acceptanceCriteria: Server-side price validation MANDATORY (recalculate total dari database prices)
Webhook signature verification untuk setiap payment callback (HMAC-SHA256)
Transaction signing implementasi untuk detect tampering
Idempotency key untuk prevent duplicate order processing
Pending transaction timeout: 15 menit (auto-cancel jika tidak completed)
Payment status synchronization dengan payment provider sebelum confirm
Merchant API keys secured dalam environment variables/key store (not hardcoded)
API key rotation policy: setiap 90 hari
Comprehensive transaction logging dengan immutable audit trail
Fraud detection rules: alert jika amount > threshold atau unusual patterns
PCI DSS compliance untuk credit card data handling
No credit card data stored di application database (use payment provider tokenization)
testCases: Attempt change order amount di frontend, verify server-side validation reject
Intercept webhook callback, modify status to 'success', verify signature check fail
Send duplicate payment callback, verify idempotency key prevent duplicate order
Wait 16 minutes for pending payment, verify auto-cancel
Send payment webhook dengan tampered signature, verify rejection
Query audit logs for payment transaction: verify immutable records exist
